description: Find icons this Claycut account already generated or edited, so you can reuse one instead of paying for a new generation. Needs a Claycut key; free. Check here before generate_app_icon. Returns concept, style, date and download URL for matches, or the account's recent icons if nothing matches.

concept.description: Word to search past concepts for, e.g. "wallet"; omit to list recent icons

name: find_my_icon
